ns2:section.sectionText: Focus is on issues related to attention and learning; multi-tasking and media-multi-tasking; learning and social experiences that are mediated and interrupted by technology; technology in the classroom; attention disorders (e.g. ADHD), learning and technology; using technology to support attention and learning and concerns related to increasing use of technology in learning environments. Undergraduate students should enroll for 3 hours and Graduate students should enroll for 4 hours.
